title: RAGtifier: Evaluating RAG Generation Approaches of State-of-the-Art RAG Systems for the SIGIR LiveRAG Competition
reasoning: The paper uses the DataMorgana framework to generate synthetic benchmarks for RAG systems. This evaluation methodology includes a specific user category persona (the Bishop of Rome) that incorporates biblical texts, religious doctrines, faith, and morality into the generated question contexts for testing the RAG system's responses.
